annex_basis: CCD 2008/48/EC Annex I Example 1 (or equivalent in Annex III of CCD 2023/2225)

result_aprc.rounding: to 1 decimal place per Annex I

assumptions_applied: Immediate full drawdown at t0
Single repayment exactly 1 year later
No charges or fees
No early repayment consideration
Day-count convention: 1 year = 1 period (no days/365 conversion needed)
weakest_point: The closed-form solution only works for single draw + single repayment. Any deviation from this pattern (irregular intervals, upfront fees, partial repayments) requires numerical iteration to solve the NPV equation.

annex_basis: CCD 2008/48/EC Annex I (Example 2 or similar fee structure) — constructed from formula knowledge

equation_setup.formula: Net_Credit = sum of PV(repayments) discounted at APRC/12 per month
equation_setup.CCD_form_per_Annex: sum of PV of all payments (drawdowns and repayments) = 0

result_aprc.rounding: to 1 decimal place per Annex I

assumptions_applied: Immediate full drawdown at t0
Equal monthly repayments (annuity structure)
Fee treated as reduction of net credit (paid at conclusion, per Annex I)
Day-count: monthly periods (1/12 year each)
No grace period
Annex I day-count convention: months treated as equal periods
weakest_point: The fee-timing assumption matters: if the fee is paid AT CONCLUSION (same day as drawdown), it reduces net credit. If paid SEPARATELY (e.g., bank transfer), the treatment differs. Annex I Example 2 specifies the exact timing convention — without access to the exact text, this case follows the standard interpretation that upfront charges reduce net credit.

annex_basis: CCD 2023/2225 Annex III (or equivalent in 2008/48 Annex I) — constructed from formula knowledge

inputs.irregularity_note: Drawdowns at months 0, 3, 8; repayments at months 6, 12

equation_setup.formula: sum(PV of drawdowns) = sum(PV of repayments) at APRC
equation_setup.where_i: i = APRC, time in months (divided by 12 for annual rate)

assumptions_applied: Drawdowns occur at the specified months (month 0 = t0 = drawdown date)
Repayments occur at specified months from drawdown date
Day-count convention: each month = 1/12 year (standard CCD convention)
Exact days not used — Annex I uses period-based (monthly) convention
First drawdown at t0 (no deferred start)
NPV equation: sum of PV(drawdowns) must equal sum of PV(repayments)
weakest_point: The day-count convention is critical: Annex I specifies how to handle irregular months. If actual days are used (e.g., 30/360), the exact period lengths differ from equal-month convention. Without the exact annex text, I apply the standard period-based (monthly) convention. The APRC is sensitive to this assumption.

annex_basis: CCD 2023/2225 Annex III / Article 25 (early repayment) — constructed from formula knowledge

equation_setup.formula: NPV of all cash flows = 0 at APRC

computation.remaining_balance_computation: PV of months 13-24 at monthly rate 0.015131

assumptions_applied: Settlement fee is included in APRC calculation (per Article 25)
Remaining balance = PV of foregone future payments at APRC rate
No compensation for early termination beyond settlement fee
CCD 2023/2225 caps settlement fee at 1% of early repayment amount (parameterized as 200 EUR here)
Remaining balance calculation uses contracted APRC rate
weakest_point: The settlement fee formula is parameterized here. CCD 2023/2225 caps compensation for early repayment at 1% of early repaid amount (or 0.5% in certain cases). Without the exact RTS, the 200 EUR fee is illustrative. Also, the remaining balance calculation must use the contracted rate (not APRC) per some member state implementations.

annex_basis: CCD 2008/48/EC Annex I — constructed from formula knowledge

equation_setup.formula: Net_Credit = sum of PV(repayments) at APRC
equation_setup.key_insight: Even at 0% nominal interest, admin fee creates positive APRC

assumptions_applied: Admin fee treated as reduction of net credit (same as upfront charges)
Equal monthly payments of 416.67
0% nominal interest rate
APRC reflects total cost including fees
Day-count: monthly periods
weakest_point: The 'zero-interest' promotional credit APRC is a key consumer protection measure — it prevents misleading advertising of '0% interest' when fees make APRC significantly above zero. The €100 admin fee on €5,000 over 12 months creates ~3.7% APRC. Larger fees or shorter terms would push APRC much higher.
